about: General concept-to-Act hints for everyday questions, by area of law (family, tenancy, consumer, workplace, cheque, property, criminal and a few others). When the words of a question match an entry, the rewrite is told which Acts usually apply, and the search always gets one query that names the Act, so a section can be found even when it never uses the user's words. One entry per CONCEPT, not per question. `when` words are matched by stem; `all` words must also occur (optional). `query` is what is searched: the Act's name and the heading words its provisions carry. Add an entry here to cover another area; no code change.
